title: Telepathic friend meets an unvoiced telepath

tellings.quote: one of the my friends who's telepathic recently had a contact with an unvoiced person

plain: In 2024, a telepathic friend of the writer Whitley Strieber is said to have met an "unvoiced person", meaning someone who talks only mind to mind and never out loud. Strieber passes this on as something his friend told him, while talking about his belief that such beings live among us. If true, it would mean people who speak only by telepathy are walking around unnoticed.
